proves.claim: With items.barRulesAtAdd on, a lane item with no spec row is refused SPEC_ROW_NEEDED, and the next step names spec draft and the same add with --specs.

cli.io-item-bar-spec-row.refused-without.why: Without it builders drafted spec rows themselves, so rows nobody approved entered the board.

proves.claim: An add naming a spec row, a coordinator-lane item, and any add with the setting off are filed as before.

cli.io-item-bar-spec-row.allowed.why: Without it the new refusal could block adds that name a row or that no rule covers.

proves.claim: The real add command on a fixture board refuses a lane add with no --specs when the setting is on and files no item.

cli.io-item-bar-spec-row.real-add.why: Without it the rule could pass as a unit while add.js never called it.
